title: Area 5150 by CRTC & Hornet (Party Version) / IBM PC+CGA Demo, Hardware Capture
summary: Area 5150 is a demoscene production for the original 4.77MHz IBM PC with CGA graphics and PC speaker. This is the Evoke 2022 party version, captured from real hardware, and it won the Alternative Demo compo.
why: HN treats it as a showcase of what clever tricks can squeeze out of 1981 hardware, and the sequel to 8088 MPH.

quote.text: This comment really summarizes just how impressive the demo is
